summary_en: Achilles to reduce strategic shareholdings to below 20% of consolidated net assets by end of FY3/28. Proceeds to be allocated to business investment and shareholder returns. Board approved policy on 7 August 2026; company will conduct dialogue with investee companies and prioritize relationship preservation during unwinding.
title_en: Notice regarding Policy on Reduction of Strategic Shareholdings
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Achilles Corporation's board of directors approved a policy to reduce strategic shareholdings. The company has set a target to decrease the ratio of strategic shareholdings to consolidated net assets to below 20% by the end of fiscal year 3/28 (31 March 2028). The company currently holds strategic shareholdings as part of its long-term growth strategy, with board-level verification of rationality conducted periodically by stock. Proceeds generated from the reduction will be deployed toward business growth investments and enhanced shareholder returns to improve capital efficiency. Going forward, the company will execute this policy while prioritizing maintenance of business relationships and will conduct careful dialogue with investee companies to secure understanding of the reduction initiative.
